description: "The Scientific Basis of Morals, and Other Essays" by William Kingdon Clifford is a philosophical treatise written in the late 19th century. This work delves into the foundations of ethics, aiming to establish a moral framework based on scientific reasoning and human experience rather than simply adhering to traditional or religious doctrines.
